fields.label: Why?
options: To hide a kindness to a hungry family
To delay an inspection that would expose private grain sales
fields.answer: To delay an inspection that would expose private grain sales

hints: [[r:Which object was moved to the steward's store?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[r:The steward, Edward Harwood, hid the order to delay an inspection that would have exposed his private grain sales. It was in the blue dispatch chest. The order is recovered, the winter relief can go ahead, and the grain accounts will be checked. The miller's assistant gave grain to a hungry family out of kindness. The steward lied to protect himself.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[r:The finale uses only the story and your notebook.]]
